title: HADEG Finnerty group: source membership audit

reviewed_primary_references.assessment: Each M-1 gene complemented alkM disruption in ADP1; this supports alkane-hydroxylase function but does not identify either protein as the soluble Finnerty dioxygenase.
Reports a purified flavin-containing n-alkane oxygenase in M-1; inspected abstract does not connect that enzyme to these accessions.
